elements_selected.content: Search implementation at base.html:704-745 fuzzy-matches across non-contiguous letters (typing "hard" hits both "hardship" and "Pharmacy Depot 2019" by matching `P**ha**rmacy **D**epot`). As the corpus grows this will confuse users. Prefer a prefix/substring match on title (case-insensitive), optionally falling back to subsequence-fuzzy when nothing matches. Body-text indexing is a larger follow-up and out of scope for this task.
